caption: A consumer starts the same way they'd start any search: the catalog search bar, or Browse assets by source and collection.
On the asset's own page, Request access is right there in the same menu as Edit and Delete — no separate ticketing system to go find.
A short justification, an optional "request for someone else" box, then Send — which is what actually fires the self-service workflow.
Once granted, the request becomes a tracked record: data source path, access type, requestor, and a date — an audit trail, not a one-time favor.

eyebrow: Every request moves through the same states

steps.label: PENDING
steps.sub: sent to an approver for review

subtitle: Access answers who can see the data. Quality answers whether it's trustworthy.
